people.name: Romamti-ezer
people.line: Son of Heman, a Levitical singer

translations.web: for the twenty-fourth to Romamti-Ezer, his sons and his brothers, twelve.
translations.bsb: and the twenty-fourth to Romamti-ezer, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all.
translations.kjv: The four and twentieth to Romamtiezer, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve.
translations.asv: for the four and twentieth to Romamtiezer, his sons and his brethren, twelve.
